def get_pair(txt,n):
 pat=rf'Demo pair {n} input \(\d+x\d+\):\n(.*?)\nDemo pair {n} output \(\d+x\d+\):\n(.*?)(?=\n\n|\nSame instance)'
 m=re.search(pat,txt,re.S)
 print('matched',bool(m))
 if not m: return None
 return [[int(x) for x in row.split()] for row in m.group(1).splitlines()], [[int(x) for x in row.split()] for row in m.group(2).splitlines()]
pairs=[get_pair(msgs[1],1),get_pair(msgs[2],2)]
print([(len(a),len(b), len(a[0]),len(b[0])) for a,b in pairs])
